name: Trip Itinerary Builder
description: Builds detailed day-by-day travel itineraries with timed activities, transit directions, meal windows, and contingency alternatives. Gathers destination, dates, traveler count, budget range, and interest preferences, then produces a structured schedule the user can print or share. Use when the user asks to plan a trip itinerary, create a day-by-day travel schedule, organize activities for a vacation, or build a sightseeing plan. Do NOT use for road trip route planning (use road-trip-planner), packing lists (use packing-list-builder), travel budgets (use budget-travel-planner), or business conference logistics.
